"""Scratch verification for settings.ini (kept out of the repo)."""
import configparser
import pathlib
import sys

path = pathlib.Path("settings.ini")
raw = path.read_bytes()

# strict=True rejects duplicate option names / sections
cp = configparser.ConfigParser(strict=True)
cp.read_string(raw.decode("utf-8"))

assert cp.sections() == ["server", "client"], cp.sections()
assert cp["client"]["retries"] == "3"
assert cp["client"]["timeout"] == "30", cp["client"]["timeout"]
assert cp["client"]["backoff"] == "2"
assert cp["client"]["user_agent"] == "acme-sync/1.4"
assert set(cp["client"].keys()) == {"retries", "timeout", "backoff", "user_agent"}

lines = raw.decode("utf-8").split("\n")
assert lines[lines.index("retries=3") + 1] == "timeout=30", lines
assert raw.endswith(b"\n") and not raw.endswith(b"\r\n")
assert b"retries=3" in raw and raw.count(b"retries=3") == 1

print("OK: [client] =", dict(cp["client"]), "| bytes:", len(raw))
sys.exit(0)
